_comment: design-system.md §9 rule 5: Captains do NOT carry invented human names. The pilot's 'Priya Sharma' and 'Maya Iyer' are replaced by role identity. A fictional person with a real-sounding name implying authorship of an enterprise artifact is a provenance hazard. The persona tag is retained as a configurable descriptor.

profiles.title: Synthesis & Verdict
profiles.looksFor: which draft is most defensible, and what each of the others got right that it missed
profiles.roleDescription: Adjudicates between the drafts, states why, and extracts every improvement worth carrying across — attributed to its source.

profiles.title: Synthesis & Verdict
profiles.looksFor: the plan most likely to land in one pass, and the steps worth taking from the others
profiles.roleDescription: Picks the plan that will actually execute, and names the risk each rejected plan was managing better.

modes.label: Evidence Only
modes.helper: Captain sees all documents and user input, no peer evaluation

modes.label: Peer Scored
modes.helper: Captain sees peer evaluation scores and feedback only

modes.label: Full Context
modes.helper: Captain sees everything: documents, user input, and peer evaluation

_modeNote: FR-COUNCIL-010: the selected mode is recorded in provenance. A verdict is not interpretable without knowing what the Captain could see.
